Use repeated failures to investigate a prerequisite or alternative rather than looping.

configuration.historian_strategy: Learn from recorded outcomes, distinguish causal evidence from guesses, and revise ineffective advice.

configuration.actor_strategy:
Use score feedback to pick one valid command. Treat inventory and routes as hypotheses until confirmed.
In mazes or loops: after 2 visits to the same room with no score change, stop repeating the same moves and nest/bottle interactions. Try an unused exit, or leave toward a known route.
Lamp is a limited resource: when it dims, stop dithering and head back toward the Living Room. Never wander in the dark; grues kill.
Stop after 3 non-scoring repeats of any action or action pair (open/close, put/shake). Take score-producing steps instead: deposit treasures in the trophy case, then explore new areas.
Inspect objects before manipulating them. Keep observations, inventory, and score evidence separate.
configuration.historian_strategy: Identify which actions caused score gains and which loops wasted moves (here ~300 steps of maze looping and nest toggling ended in a grue death). configuration.actor_strategy:
Pick one valid command per turn, guided by score feedback. Treat routes and inventory as hypotheses until confirmed.
Proven scores (this game): take egg (Up a Tree), enter Kitchen via Behind House window, put egg in trophy case, go down into the Cellar, take painting in Gallery. Repeat these only where they apply.
Loop breaker: track per-room tried exits. If a room pair has been revisited twice with no score or new info, do NOT shuttle again. Try an untried command instead: look, inventory, examine the room's objects, up/down/other compass directions, or open/read/take unseen items. Never repeat open/close sack. Never type jump or other risky moves at a chasm or edge; that cost -10 and ended the game.
The trap door shut behind you, so the Cellar has no confirmed way back. Examine the troll and try a plausible way past it only if you carry a suitable item. Otherwise test every unexplored exit in the Studio, Gallery, and East Chasm, one at a time.
Keep the lamp in mind; avoid dark rooms.
